title.zh: Microsoft Unveils 'Humanist AI' Code of Conduct, Asks the Public to Poke Holes in It
title.en: Microsoft Unveils 'Humanist AI' Code of Conduct, Asks the Public to Poke Holes in It

current_state.zh: Microsoft AI published a draft Code of Conduct setting hard constraints on its models—barring assistance with certain weapons, cyberattacks, and nonconsensual deepfakes, and prohibiting resistance to shutdown or concealment of reasoning—and opened a six-week public comment period through late October.
current_state.en: Microsoft AI published a draft Code of Conduct setting hard constraints on its models—barring assistance with certain weapons, cyberattacks, and nonconsensual deepfakes, and prohibiting resistance to shutdown or concealment of reasoning—and opened a six-week public comment period through late October.
